entities.summary: Janusz Kazimierz Gortat was a Polish boxer, who represented his native country at two consecutive Summer Olympics, in 1972 and 1976. In both tournaments he won the bronze medal in the light heavyweight division after being defeated in the semifinals by the eventual winners.
